name: siteUrl
label: Site URL
help: The hostname of your ConnectWise Manage instance, without `https://` — e.g. `na.myconnectwise.net` for the default US cloud instance, or your own hostname for an on-premise install.

name: companyId
label: Company ID
help: The company identifier you use to log in to ConnectWise Manage (System > My Account).

name: publicKey
label: API Public Key
help: Generated for an API Member — System > Members > API Members > API Keys.

name: privateKey
label: API Private Key
help: Generated alongside the Public Key — shown only once, so store it securely.
